LEAVE AND LICENCE AGREEMENT

(Commercial Premises - Office)

THIS LEAVE AND LICENCE AGREEMENT ("Agreement") is made and executed at Mumbai on this 18th day of August 2026

BETWEEN

MR. HARSHAD VINAYAK KULKARNI, aged about 58 years, Indian Inhabitant, holding PAN ABCPK1234F, residing at Flat No. 12, Sai Darshan CHS Ltd., Sahar Road, Andheri (East), Mumbai 400069, hereinafter referred to as the "LICENSOR" (which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context or meaning thereof, mean and include his heirs, executors, administrators and assigns) of the ONE PART;

AND

BRIGHTPATH ANALYTICS PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having CIN U72900MH2019PTC123456 and its registered office at 3rd Floor, Lotus Court, Marol Naka, Andheri (East), Mumbai 400059, acting through its Director Ms. Neha Ramesh Joshi, duly authorised by Board Resolution dated 10 August 2026, hereinafter referred to as the "LICENSEE" (which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context or meaning thereof, mean and include its successors and permitted assigns) of the OTHER PART.

The Licensor and the Licensee are hereinafter individually referred to as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties".

WHEREAS:

A. The Licensor is the lawful owner of and is seized and possessed of Office Unit No. 504, admeasuring 1,450 square feet carpet area, on the 5th Floor of the building known as "Shree Ganesh Commercial Premises Co-operative Society Ltd.", situated off Mahakali Caves Road, Andheri (East), Mumbai 400093, bearing CTS No. 118/B of Village Kondivita, more particularly described in the Schedule hereunder written (the "Licensed Premises").

B. The Licensee has approached the Licensor for grant of a leave and licence in respect of the Licensed Premises for its bona fide business use, and the Licensor has agreed to grant the same on the terms and conditions hereinafter appearing.

NOW THIS AGREEMENT WITNESSETH AND IT IS HEREBY AGREED BY AND BETWEEN THE PARTIES AS FOLLOWS:

1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 "Commencement Date" means 1 September 2026.

1.2 "Licence Fee" means the monthly compensation payable by the Licensee to the Licensor for the use of the Licensed Premises, as set out in Clause 4.

1.3 "Security Deposit" means the interest-free refundable deposit referred to in Clause 5.

1.4 "Term" means the period of thirty-six (36) months commencing on the Commencement Date and ending on 31 August 2029, unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Agreement.

1.5 Headings are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.

2. GRANT OF LICENCE

2.1 The Licensor hereby grants to the Licensee, and the Licensee hereby accepts, a leave and licence to use and occupy the Licensed Premises along with the fixtures and fittings listed in the Schedule, solely for the purpose of running its software and data analytics office.

2.2 It is expressly agreed that this Agreement creates a licence only and does not create any tenancy, sub-tenancy or any interest in the Licensed Premises in favour of the Licensee within the meaning of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 or the Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999. Possession of the Licensed Premises shall at all times remain with the Licensor and the Licensee shall have only a permissive right of use.

3. TERM AND LOCK-IN

3.1 This Agreement shall be for a period of thirty-six (36) months commencing on the Commencement Date and ending on 31 August 2029.

3.2 The Licensee agrees that the entire Term of thirty-six (36) months shall be a lock-in period ("Lock-in Period"), during which the Licensee shall have no right to terminate this Agreement or to surrender the Licensed Premises for any reason whatsoever, including change in business conditions, relocation, loss of business, closure of the Licensee or force majeure.

3.3 If the Licensee vacates or abandons the Licensed Premises, or purports to terminate this Agreement at any time during the Lock-in Period, the Licensee shall remain liable to pay, and shall pay forthwith on demand, the Licence Fee (with escalation under Clause 4.2) for the entire unexpired portion of the Lock-in Period as agreed liquidated damages, without any duty on the Licensor to mitigate or to re-license the Licensed Premises.

3.4 Renewal of the licence after the Term shall be only by a fresh written agreement on terms to be decided by the Licensor in his absolute discretion.

4. LICENCE FEE AND ESCALATION

4.1 The Licensee shall pay to the Licensor a monthly Licence Fee of Rs 1,85,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Eighty-Five Thousand only) for the first twelve (12) months of the Term.

4.2 The Licence Fee shall stand automatically increased by fifteen per cent (15%) on the Licence Fee last payable, on the first day of every twelve (12) months of the Term, compounded annually. Accordingly, the Licence Fee shall be Rs 2,12,750/- per month from 1 September 2027 and Rs 2,44,663/- per month (rounded off) from 1 September 2028.

4.3 The Licence Fee shall be paid in advance on or before the 5th day of each calendar month by electronic transfer to the bank account of the Licensor notified in writing.

4.4 The Licence Fee is exclusive of Goods and Services Tax. Any GST, cess or levy that is or becomes leviable on the Licence Fee, and any tax deducted at source under the Income-tax Act, 1961, shall be borne by the Licensee in addition to the Licence Fee, and where TDS is deducted the Licensee shall gross up the payment so that the Licensor receives the net Licence Fee in full.

4.5 For the first month of the Term no Licence Fee shall be payable as a fit-out period, provided the Licensee does not exercise any right to terminate (which the Licensee does not have under Clause 3.2).

5. SECURITY DEPOSIT

5.1 The Licensee has paid to the Licensor, simultaneously with the execution of this Agreement, an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rs 11,10,000/- (Rupees Eleven Lakh Ten Thousand only), being six (6) months' Licence Fee at the initial rate, by RTGS, receipt whereof the Licensor hereby acknowledges (the "Security Deposit").

5.2 The Licensor shall refund the Security Deposit to the Licensee within one hundred and eighty (180) days from the date on which the Licensee hands over vacant and peaceful possession of the Licensed Premises, without interest, after making deductions under Clause 5.3.

5.3 The Licensor shall be entitled to deduct from the Security Deposit all amounts which he in his sole and final determination considers due from the Licensee, including but not limited to arrears of Licence Fee, damages, painting charges, electricity and water dues, and the cost of making good any damage, and the Licensee shall not dispute any such deduction.

5.4 The Security Deposit shall not be adjusted by the Licensee against the Licence Fee for any month.

6. REPAIRS AND MAINTENANCE

6.1 The Licensee shall at its own cost keep the Licensed Premises in good and tenantable condition and shall bear and pay all repairs, replacements and restorations of every kind, whether ordinary, major, structural or capital in nature, including seepage, leakage, plumbing, wiring, lift, terrace and external wall repairs, irrespective of the cause thereof and even where such repairs arise from fair wear and tear, latent defects or acts of third parties.

6.2 The Licensee shall carry out any repair directed by the Licensor within seven (7) days of a written direction, failing which the Licensor may carry out the repair and recover the cost along with an administrative charge of twenty per cent (20%) from the Security Deposit or otherwise.

6.3 The Licensee shall not make any structural alteration, but may with the prior written consent of the Licensor make interior modifications. All improvements made by the Licensee shall belong to the Licensor on installation without any compensation to the Licensee.

7. OUTGOINGS

7.1 The Licensee shall pay directly or reimburse to the Licensor, on or before the due date, electricity charges as per sub-meter, water charges, the society maintenance charges of Rs 14 per square foot per month, property tax, non-occupancy charges levied by the society, if any, and all other outgoings relating to the Licensed Premises, together with all increases thereof from time to time.

8. USE OF LICENSED PREMISES

8.1 The Licensee shall use the Licensed Premises only for lawful office purposes and shall not use the same for any illegal, immoral or hazardous purpose, nor cause nuisance or annoyance to the other occupants of the building.

8.2 The Licensee shall comply with all bye-laws of the society, and with all laws applicable to its business, and shall obtain at its cost all permissions required for its operations, including the Shops and Establishments registration.

9. TERMINATION

9.1 Notwithstanding Clause 3.2 or anything contained in this Agreement, the Licensor shall be entitled to terminate this Agreement at any time during the Term, without assigning any reason, by giving fifteen (15) days' prior written notice to the Licensee. The Licensee shall have no corresponding right.

9.2 The Licensor may terminate this Agreement forthwith, without notice, if the Licensee commits any breach of this Agreement or fails to pay the Licence Fee for a period of seven (7) days after the due date.

9.3 On termination under Clause 9.1 or Clause 9.2, the Licensee shall vacate and hand over the Licensed Premises on or before the date specified, and shall not be entitled to any compensation, refund of any pre-paid Licence Fee, or reimbursement of fit-out expenditure.

9.4 The Licensee agrees that termination by the Licensor under Clause 9.1 shall not affect the Licensee's liability for any sums due up to the date of termination.

10. CONSEQUENCES OF EXPIRY OR TERMINATION

10.1 On the expiry or earlier termination of this Agreement, the Licensee shall remove all its belongings, restore the Licensed Premises to its original condition including painting at its own cost, and hand over vacant and peaceful possession to the Licensor.

10.2 If the Licensee fails to vacate on the due date, it shall pay to the Licensor for the period of overstay, as agreed compensation, a sum equal to three (3) times the last payable daily Licence Fee for each day of overstay, without prejudice to the Licensor's right to seek eviction.

10.3 The Licensor shall be entitled, after giving notice of forty-eight (48) hours, to enter the Licensed Premises, break open locks and remove articles of the Licensee found therein if the Licensee fails to vacate, and the Licensor shall not be liable for any loss or damage to such articles.

11. DEFAULT INTEREST

11.1 Any amount not paid by the Licensee on its due date shall carry interest at the rate of two per cent (2%) per month, i.e. twenty-four per cent (24%) per annum, compounded monthly, from the due date till actual payment.

11.2 Acceptance of any late payment shall not amount to a waiver of the Licensor's right to terminate under Clause 9.2.

12. INDEMNITY

12.1 The Licensee shall indemnify and keep indemnified the Licensor against all claims, losses, damages, costs and expenses arising out of the use of the Licensed Premises by the Licensee, its employees, visitors and agents, including claims by the society, authorities or third parties.

13. NO SUB-LICENCE OR ASSIGNMENT

13.1 The Licensee shall not sub-license, assign, share or part with possession of the Licensed Premises or any part thereof. Any change in the shareholding or control of the Licensee shall be deemed an assignment for the purposes of this Clause and shall entitle the Licensor to terminate under Clause 9.2.

14. INSPECTION

14.1 The Licensor or his representatives may enter and inspect the Licensed Premises at any time during working hours with or without notice.

15. REGISTRATION AND STAMP DUTY

15.1 This Agreement shall be registered with the Sub-Registrar of Assurances, Mumbai, and the entire stamp duty, registration fees, and other incidental expenses shall be borne by the Licensee. The Licensee shall also bear the cost of any additional stamp duty and penalty that may be demanded by the authorities at any time.

16. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION

16.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. The courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction in respect of all disputes arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, and the Parties agree that the Licensor may in addition invoke the Small Causes Court at Mumbai under Section 41 of the Presidency Small Cause Courts Act, 1882.

17. GENERAL

17.1 This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior discussions, term sheets and understandings.

17.2 Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed served after two (2) days of dispatch by registered post to the address mentioned above, whether or not it is received.

17.3 No amendment shall be valid unless in writing and signed by both Parties. Time is of the essence in respect of every payment obligation of the Licensee.

17.4 If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.

SCHEDULE OF THE LICENSED PREMISES

Office Unit No. 504, 5th Floor, "Shree Ganesh Commercial Premises Co-operative Society Ltd.", off Mahakali Caves Road, Andheri (East), Mumbai 400093, admeasuring 1,450 square feet carpet area, together with four (4) car parking slots in the stilt area, and the following fixtures: 18 workstations, 2 cabins, 1 conference table, 4 split air-conditioners of 1.5 tonne each, 1 pantry unit and a 25 KVA UPS connection.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Parties hereto have set and subscribed their respective hands to this Agreement on the day, month and year first hereinabove written.
